mapper.select: SELECT s.industry, COUNT(*) AS stockCount, ROUND(AVG(d.change_percent), 2) AS avgChangePct, SUM(CASE WHEN d.change_percent > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.change_percent > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS upRatio FROM stock_daily d JOIN stock s ON d.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE d.trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND s.industry IS NOT NULL AND s.industry != '' GROUP BY s.industry ORDER BY avgChangePct DESC

SELECT s.stock_code AS stockCode, s.stock_name AS stockName, s.market, s.industry, s.pe AS pe, d.close_price AS price, d.change_percent AS changePct, ROUND(d.close_price - d.pre_close, 2) AS `change`, d.volume, d.high_price AS highPrice, d.low_price AS lowPrice FROM stock s LEFT JOIN stock_daily d ON s.stock_code = d.stock_code AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_daily)
AND (s.stock_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.stock_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.industry = #{industry}
ORDER BY d.close_price ASC
ORDER BY d.close_price DESC
ORDER BY d.change_percent ASC
ORDER BY d.change_percent DESC
ORDER BY d.volume ASC
ORDER BY d.volume DESC
ORDER BY d.change_percent DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
